stories.headline: AWS data centers in UAE and Bahrain hit by drone strikes, disrupting cloud services across Middle East
key_facts: Two of three AWS Availability Zones in UAE region (ME-CENTRAL-1) directly struck by drones; one Bahrain facility (ME-SOUTH-1) damaged
Structural damage, power disruptions, and fires requiring suppression reported; water damage from firefighting efforts
Amazon EC2, S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, and RDS experiencing elevated error rates and degraded availability
AWS warned restoration 'will be prolonged given the nature of the physical damage' and urged customers to migrate workloads to US, Europe, or Asia Pacific
First time a major US hyperscaler's data centers have been disrupted by military action
Amazon shares closed down 0.77% at $208.39 on Monday, fell another 0.47% after-hours

stories.headline: TSMC building up to 10 fabs in Taiwan, accelerates Arizona 3nm plant months ahead of schedule

Arizona Fab 21 phase 2 will begin 3nm equipment installation in Q3 2026, targeting production in 2027 — several quarters ahead of original 2028 schedule
Capital expenditure guided at $52-56 billion for 2026, a roughly 30% year-over-year jump
Kaohsiung Fab 22 (2nm) has 5 phases: P1 in volume production, P2 in trial production, P3-P5 under construction
Apple, Nvidia, and AMD have secured the bulk of Arizona Fab 21 capacity
Tainan Special Zone A planned for additional 2nm fabs; construction could begin May 2026 pending environmental review

stories.headline: Waymo expands to 10 US cities simultaneously, targets 1 million robotaxi rides per week by year-end
key_facts: Waymo launched autonomous ride-hailing in Dallas, Houston, San Antonio, and Orlando simultaneously — first time opening multiple cities at once
Now operating in 10 US metro areas; currently handling over 450,000 rides per week
Co-CEO Tekedra Mawakana confirmed target of over 1 million paid weekly rides by end of 2026
Plans to expand to 20+ cities including first overseas launches in London and Tokyo
Logged over 200 million fully autonomous miles on public roads; safety data shows significant reductions in serious-injury crashes vs human drivers
Houston service area covers approximately 25 square miles within I-610 loop including downtown, Midtown, Montrose, and Houston Heights

stories.headline: SpaceX targets mid-March for Starship V3 first flight with 100-ton payload and Raptor 3 engines
key_facts: Starship V3 Flight 12 targeting mid-March launch from Boca Chica; FAA has granted flight-safety approval
V3 stands 408 feet (124m) tall, can carry over 100 metric tons to LEO — nearly triple V2's approximately 35-ton capacity
New Raptor 3 engines produce nearly double the thrust of Raptor 1 while costing four times less to manufacture
Mission objectives include first orbital attempt, in-space propellant transfer test, and Starship upper stage landing/recovery
V3 is the first version built for NASA Artemis 3 Human Landing System requirements including orbital refueling
Previous delay caused by Super Heavy Booster 18 damage during late-2025 testing

stories.headline: Honor unveils moonwalking humanoid robot at MWC 2026 alongside 4DoF gimbal 'Robot Phone'
key_facts: Honor revealed its first-ever humanoid robot at MWC 2026 in Barcelona, performing choreographed moonwalk and backflip on stage
Robot being developed for three roles: shopping assistance, workplace inspections, and supportive companionship
Honor also previewed 'Robot Phone' — a smartphone with 4DoF gimbal system combining embodied AI with robot-grade motion control
Robot Phone uses ultra-compact motors enabling cinematic imaging with spatial awareness; release targeted for H2 2026
Marks major expansion for Honor beyond smartphones and laptops into full-scale robotics and embodied intelligence
Pricing and commercial availability for the humanoid robot not yet announced
